text:
raj: Flipped ARCH_AWARE_PICK=1 on canary for ampere pools. p95 up ~12% on seqlen~512. Telemetry shows a lot of picks labeled 'heuristic_hysteresis'. Anyone else?
maria: Yep saw that starting ~11:30. Logs show pick_reason=hysteresis and chosen_kernel=bfd_fast32 even when fallback_fast16 had lower exec_time_est. Wonder if sampling rate skewed the estimator.
lee: perf-bot trace has CPU stalls at kernel-init when KV cache miss spike. Also saw more small batches. Could be batching heuristics interacting.
jordan: Hypothesis: seq_len boundary at 480 vs 512 causing bucket flip-flop + hysteresis threshold too low. Recommend increasing RDW_PICK_HYSTERESIS or lowering RDW_PICK_SAMPLE_RATE.
raj: I dumped a few telemetry lines: 
```json
{"ts":"2112233445","model":"longchat-3b","arch":"ampere","seq_len":512,"chosen_kernel":"fast32_batched","reason":"seq_bucket(512)->heuristic_hysteresis","est_latency_ms":1.8,"sample_rate":0.03,"kv_miss":5}
```
perf-bot: Flamegraph uploaded: https://redwood/fg/2112233445 (shows kernel init at top). Auto-sampled picks: 3%.
maria: Can we add debug env REDWOOD_PICK_LOG_LEVEL=debug and RDW_PICK_HYSTERESIS=0.12 on the canary for 30m? Also increase pick telemetry sampling to 10% for that shard.
lee: Agree. Also add a quick probe: force_pick=fast16 for a slice to compare end-to-end latency and token cost.
raj: :thumbsup: I'll roll flags in the canary now and collect another telemetry dump in 30m. If perf improves we can try a small rollout.
jordan: One more: please ensure telemetry includes 'fallback_score' and 'cpu_init_ms' fields — saved us before. I'll add a small serializer change.
